children: Reliance Global Group entered into a Purchase and Contribution Agreement to sell Southwestern Montana Insurance Center to Scali Insurance Group. The deal provides $2.625 million in cash at closing, based on 8.75x pro forma EBITDA of $300,000, with additional uncapped contingent consideration equal to 8.75 times any EBITDA above $300,000 for the 12 months starting September 1, 2026. Closing is effective as of September 1, 2026 for accounting purposes, with final payment due no later than September 11, 2026. The sale includes SMI's equity and its full book of business and assets.
: Purchase and Contribution Agreement for sale of SMI equity and assets
: Refocus portfolio and raise cash from non-core asset
